s1.desc: a bathroom drawn on a plain pale grey background

s2.desc: an empty space with a plain pale grey background

spans.notes: Polly half out of the picture at the left, wiping the mirror, sparkles (15 frames before the zoom out)
zoom out from the mirror to the wide bathroom; the mirror frame settles at 46-47

spans.view: with a cream double-sink vanity under a mirror in a peach frame

beats.text: Pax waddles in from the left while Polly stands by the vanity with a yellow cloth and a spray bottle
Pax stops by the sinks with one flipper raised while Polly glances up and sparkles twinkle around the vanity
Polly picks up the trash bag and turns round to face Pax, the spray bottle and cloth in her other flipper
Pax blows Polly a kiss with his eyes closed as a little heart floats up by the mirror
Pax turns his back and reaches toward the sink while Polly watches him

spans.notes: Mirror frame and vanity edges identical 47-98 (camera locked). Pax is already a sliver at the left edge at 47. The mirror shows no reflections. | verification pass 2 (verify3_report_1): Polly never wipes the counter. Over f47-64 she stands still to the right of the vanity, holding the yellow cloth and the purple spray bottle, glancing up (blink at f49). Beats 47-56 and 56-65 both say she wipes.; Polly picks up the trash bag at f64-65 as she turns, and carries it for the rest of the span; beat 65-74 leaves this out.; Camera locked: the mirror and vanity edges are black in compare

spans.view: with a round teal sink, its tap and a glass of water on the counter in front of him

beats.text: Pax squeezes a long ribbon of toothpaste from the tube onto his toothbrush
Pax puts the toothbrush in his beak as the tube drops onto the counter
Pax scrubs his teeth hard while foam swells up and spreads over his face

spans.notes: Pax seen only as his reflection in the mirror (glass sheen over him, washed-out colours), scrubbing with foam and flying droplets. Camera locked. Dropped as unsure: a reflection is a depiction of the lead, not the lead itself, and the colours are off-model.

beats.text: Polly stands frozen holding a spray bottle, a cloth and a trash bag, staring ahead with her beak open and blinking

spans.view: with a vanity, a running sink and a mirror, and a puddle spreading on the floor

beats.text: Pax leans over the running sink, scooping up water in his flippers
Pax splashes the water over his face, sending droplets flying onto the mirror
Pax leans back over the overflowing sink for more water
Pax splashes his face again, spraying water over the mirror and the floor
Pax reaches back into the overflowing sink as water spills off the counter into the puddle

spans.notes: Pax seen from behind at three-quarter view; the mirror gets covered in droplets but shows no reflection. | verification pass 2 (verify2_report_5): Beat 244-253 says Pax 'keeps scrubbing his face': from f242 he leans back over the sink and reaches into it again with his flipper while water spills off the counter. He is not at his face. Locked (vanity and mirror black 208/230/252).

beats.text: Polly stands holding the spray bottle, cloth and trash bag, staring in shock with a sweat drop on her face
Polly lets the spray bottle, the cloth and the trash bag fall to the floor
Polly stands still with empty flippers and her beak hanging open, the dropped things at her feet

spans.notes: The d1 spikes at 267-268 are the drop, not a cut; Polly's outline stays exactly in place.

spans.view: with the vanity and a droplet-covered mirror, and bottles, a razor, soap and towels strewn across the wet floor

beats.text: Pax dabs his face dry with a teal towel, eyes closed and smiling
Pax lets the towel drop to the floor
Pax stands with a pleased smile in the messy bathroom
Polly rushes in from the right toward Pax
Polly grabs Pax by the face and shoves him up toward the mirror

spans.notes: Mirror, vanity and floor clutter identical 291-320; the camera pulls back from 321.
